Name: Revised farmer Characters
Author: OneCubic
Description:
[color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25974/][color=#ff0000][size=6]Now you can download the [CP] pattern I just released, it doesn't need to be replaced, it's here

[size=4]mod是XNB文件，需要自己替换原游戏文件，替换前可以进行备份。[/size]
[size=4]替换路径：Stardewvalley→Content→Characters→Farmer[/size][/color]

[size=4]对男女农民的鞋子裤子和袖子、以及侧面的站姿做了细微的修改，让其看起来变得更和谐更舒服。
文件里面有【hats】可以选择不替换，那里面我修改了个别帽子，让它们更适配发型。
有什么bug可以评论反馈。[/size]

下面是作者的碎碎念……
原版的农夫模型实在是奇怪，那个大脚丫子抢眼球不说，还总是令人感到粗糙。之前我做过修改鞋子的mod，但是随后发现动这小小的一点就要改变很多很多去适配。于是我花了很长的时间修改了裤子对鞋子的适配。现在还有一些特殊的裙子和短裤没做修改，每次一打开裤子的图片，看到那些密密麻麻的像素就头疼……当然，除这些之外，其余所有的已经是完美了。
在制作mod的时候，我边玩存档边做修改，都成“盯帧”了。发现什么不太对劲或者不顺眼的地方我就去修改，改到现在，我是非常之满意的！所以放出来分享给大家了。


[color=#ff0000][size=4]mod is an XNB file, you need to replace the original game file yourself, you can backup before replacement.
Altnatpasta: Stardewvalley→Content→Characters→Farmer[/size][/color]
[size=4]Slight modifications were made to the standing posture of the shoes, trousers and sleeves of the men and women farmers, as well as the side, to make them look more harmonious and comfortable.
There are [hats] in the file that you can choose not to replace, which I modified the individual hats to make them more suitable for the hairstyle.
Any bugs can be commented feedback.[/size]

Here's what the author wants to say, the unimportant nonsense:
The original farmer model is really strange, the big shoe takes up a lot of vision, and always feels rough.I have done mods to modify shoes before, but then found that moving this small point requires a lot of changes to fit. So I spent a lot of time modifying the fit of the pants to the shoes. There are still some special skirts and shorts that have not been modified, and every time I open the picture of the pants, I get a headache when I see those dense pixels... Of course, apart from these, everything else is already perfect.
When making the mod, I made changes while playing with the archive, and my eyes were almost ruined.  【 Exaggeration, actually is false. My eyes are fine ;) 】
Find what is not right or unpleasant place I go to modify, change to now, I am very satisfied!   So I put it out there for you to share.
